drafts.walkScript: Lines 48 and 49 say a door was "mistaken for a cupboard's" "the night before". Line 4 says "We're in the new house", so that night was their first there. Lines 53 and 54 call the food "the supper we ought to have had last night." So "agitation" is "the upset and muddle of arriving late at night". On line 48 "half darkness" is a second thing, and nothing is stirred or found then.

Line 44 says "Somebody has to keep the goal." Line 43 says "I'm not shifting out of there," so "there" means the goal. The speaker is staying put in goal and will not leave it. So "shifting" means "Moving away from a place." Stacking jumpers is line 42, and nobody changes shape or works a turn at a job.
